msg: Olá! Somos um casal do Brasil, estamos em Cartagena até domingo. Queremos fazer snorkel nas Ilhas do Rosário, mas minha esposa enjoa muito no barco. Vocês têm alguma dica? Quanto custa?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Snorkeling in the Rosario Islands is a lovely way to enjoy the reef, and we can help you plan around the boat ride.

For motion sickness, the general tips are to have a light breakfast and consider seasickness tablets. The speedboat ride from Cartagena takes about an hour each way.

It includes boat transport, snorkeling gear, two guided sessions, lunch, insurance, and the National Park entrance fee. The meeting point is Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m., with an estimated return to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch included
• Snorkeling Tour: 126 USD · 140 USD
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• Snorkeling Tour: 45 USD · 50 USD

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Sim, saímos de Cartagena. Queremos reservar o snorkel para sábado, nós dois. Podemos pagar com cartão brasileiro?
reply:
Yes, you can pay with a Brazilian card. International bookings are paid 100% by card on our website; with a foreign card, use your passport as the ID document. The online booking link is here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/superficio/3?language=en, and the 10% online discount is applied automatically. If the website or payment fails, the team can send a bank-transfer payment link and the online discount is kept.

🤿 *Snorkeling Tour*
💰 *126 USD* per person (online rate) · 2 people
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, activity insurance, boat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 2 guided sessions with a local guide, snorkeling equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/superficio/3?language=en

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿
